Name: Animal Call
Description: A device or whistle that mimics animal sounds, useful for luring or communicating with specific types of animals.

Name: Animal Harness
Description: A harness for controlling and directing working animals, allowing them to pull carts or perform tasks.

Name: Animal Repellent
Description: Chemical or alchemical substance that repels common animals, keeping them at a distance.

Name: Aquarium Ball
Description: A glass sphere filled with water for transporting aquatic creatures safely on land.

Name: Aquatic Pinger
Description: Device that emits sounds underwater to attract or communicate with aquatic animals.

Name: Barding (Large creature)
Description: Armor for Large creatures. Costs 4 times the standard armor cost and weighs twice as much.

Name: Barding (Medium creature)
Description: Armor for Medium creatures. Costs 2 times the standard armor cost and weighs the same as normal armor.

Name: Barding Stitches
Description: Special reinforced stitching used to repair or strengthen barding.

Name: Beast Whistle
Description: A whistle designed to train or command beasts, producing sounds animals respond to.

Name: Beast-Training Kit
Description: Tools and equipment for training beasts and exotic animals, including rewards, restraints, and training aids.

Name: Bird Feed (per day)
Description: One day's worth of food for a bird, including seeds, grains, and other suitable nutrition.

Name: Bird-Training Kit
Description: Specialized equipment for training falcons, hawks, and other birds, including hoods, lures, and treats.

Name: Bit and Bridle
Description: Essential equipment for controlling a mount, consisting of a bit that goes in the mouth and bridle straps.

Name: Cage (Diminutive or Fine)
Description: Small cage for tiny creatures like mice, insects, or fairies.

Name: Cage (Huge)
Description: Massive cage for containing Huge creatures.

Name: Cage (Large)
Description: Large cage for containing Large animals or creatures.

Name: Cage (Small or Medium)
Description: Standard cage for Small or Medium-sized creatures like dogs, cats, or humanoids.

Name: Cage (Tiny)
Description: Cage for Tiny creatures like rats, ravens, or small reptiles.

Name: Caparison
Description: Decorative cloth covering for a horse or mount, often displaying heraldry or colors.

Name: Carnivore Feed (per day)
Description: One day's worth of meat and protein for carnivorous animals.

Name: Dandy Brush
Description: Grooming brush for removing dirt and loose hair from horses and other mounts.

Name: Dragon Muzzle
Description: Reinforced muzzle designed to prevent young or small dragons from using their breath weapons.

Name: Enraging Whip
Description: Whip designed to enrage animals, making them more aggressive and difficult to control.

Name: Falconry Gauntlet
Description: Heavy leather glove that protects the hand and arm when handling birds of prey.

Name: Feed (per day)
Description: One day's worth of standard feed for herbivorous animals like horses, cattle, or pack animals.

Name: Flying Straps (masterwork)
Description: Superior quality straps for securing a rider to a flying mount, providing better security and control.

Name: Flying Straps (standard)
Description: Straps that secure a rider to a flying mount like a griffon, pegasus, or hippogriff.

Name: Gorthek Saddle
Description: Specialized saddle designed for riding gortheks, large quadrupedal creatures.

Name: Hellknight Barding
Description: Distinctive armor for mounts used by Hellknights, often heavily spiked and intimidating.

Name: Hide Dye
Description: Dye used to color an animal's fur, hide, or feathers, often for identification or disguise.

Name: Horn Harness
Description: Harness that attaches to the horns of creatures, allowing them to pull heavy loads.

Name: Horse Whip
Description: Long whip used to direct and encourage horses and similar mounts.

Name: Howdah
Description: Carriage or platform mounted on the back of a large creature like an elephant, allowing multiple passengers to ride.

Name: Incubation Stove
Description: Specialized heating device for incubating eggs, maintaining optimal temperature and humidity.

Name: Mammoth Goad
Description: Long pole with a pointed tip used to direct mammoths and other massive creatures.

Name: Mastodon Brush
Description: Large, sturdy brush for grooming mastodons, mammoths, and other huge animals.

Name: Mithral Horseshoes
Description: Lightweight horseshoes made of mithral that don't tire the mount as quickly and last longer than iron shoes.

Name: Owlbear Blinders
Description: Blinders designed for owlbears to limit their peripheral vision and make them easier to control.

Name: Poh Armor
Description: Specialized armor designed for poh mounts, providing protection without restricting movement.

Name: Poison Caps
Description: Caps placed over claws, horns, or tusks that can hold poison for delivery during attacks.

Name: Qadiran Saddle
Description: Lightweight, ornate saddle from Qadira, designed for comfort during long desert rides.

Name: Saddle (exotic, military)
Description: Military-grade saddle for exotic mounts, providing secure seating during combat.

Name: Saddle (exotic, pack)
Description: Saddle designed for exotic creatures used as pack animals.

Name: Saddle (exotic, riding)
Description: Saddle designed for riding exotic creatures like giant lizards or unusual beasts.

Name: Saddle (military)
Description: Sturdy saddle designed for combat, providing bonuses to Ride checks and better security.

Name: Saddle (pack)
Description: Simple saddle designed for pack animals, with attachment points for cargo.

Name: Saddle (riding)
Description: Standard saddle for everyday riding, providing comfort and basic control.

Name: Saddlebags
Description: Bags that attach to a saddle for carrying supplies. Can hold 20 pounds per side.

Name: Stabling (per day)
Description: One day's cost for housing an animal in a stable, including feed and basic care.

Name: Target Dummy
Description: Practice target for training animals in attack or combat behaviors. Cost varies by quality.

Name: Thorny Breastplate
Description: Spiked barding for the chest of a mount, dealing damage to creatures that attack it.

Name: Training Harness
Description: Harness with attachment points for training animals to pull, carry, or perform tasks.

Name: Training Sleeve
Description: Padded sleeve for training attack animals, protecting the trainer from bites during practice.

Name: Traveling Bee Hive
Description: Portable bee hive for transporting bees, useful for beekeepers or those who use bees for pollination or defense.

Name: Tusk Blades
Description: Metal blades attached to the tusks of elephants, boars, or similar creatures to increase damage.

Name: Whet Bone
Description: Specialized bone used to maintain and sharpen an animal's teeth or claws.

Name: Whip, Training
Description: Lighter whip designed for animal training, making noise without causing significant harm.
